name: customer-researcher
title: Customer Researcher
description: Research companies live in a driven browser and save verified findings to a Postgres table.

operations.name: open
operations.description: Compose the researcher surface and open its window; with input "docked", compose it without a window.

operations.name: research
operations.description: Queue a company by name, location or website; the queue and status neurons show the outcome.

operations.name: stop
operations.description: Stop active and queued research without removing saved records.

operations.name: result
operations.description: Read the stored research row for a company query into {app}/result/{requestId}, or null.
